pro_course_detail.title: The Simple Outline for Writing in English
pro_course_detail.description:
Create an informal but very useful outline for any writing project in English: emails,  essays, articles, speeches, work memos and more . A good outline helps you remember all the thoughts you want to write. This is especially true when you write in English which has such a huge vocabulary.

And no one is going to see your outline except you.  So, you don't have to be neat, put it onto a specific format, or concentrate on spelling or grammar.  An outline will benefit you no matter what your English level -  from intermediate to proficient.

In this class you'll learn:
*How to get over the dread of doing an outline.
* Why an outline works a lot better then memorizing ideas and details.
*The difference between a informal and academic outline.
* The wonderful fact that you don't have to follow your outline to successfully write. You can change your mind about what to write - or you can change your outline.

We'll start right away on your outline.  First you'll pick your writing topic.  Next, you'll write down your thoughts about what you want to communicate in your writing.  If you can't think of anything to write about, I'll interview you to find out your interests.  We'll then turn your outline into to a real piece of writing that you can use.

Class Expectations:
1. Keep a flexible mind when writing an outline and be open to ideas from me,  your teacher.
2. At the same time, prepare to write independently after a couple of sessions.
3. Expect homework on writing outlines or changing outlines into the final writing project.
4. Ask questions!

I look forward to having you in my class.
